messages:
Maya CS: Quick pulse from onboarding calls this morning — capturing feature asks and pain points we should hand to product. TL;DR: three recurring asks + two high churn signals.

Maya CS: Asks: 1) per-route billing toggle (customers want to stop logging cheap experimental routes to avoid noise in cost) 2) embedding batch endpoint with progress updates (long queues are an onboarding blocker) 3) ability to pin model variants per-environment in Console UI.

Priya CS: + a few verbatim quotes: 'We can't reconcile token spikes across teams', 'Embeds take 8-12s during peaks', 'Dev sandbox keeps falling back to smaller model unexpectedly'.

Jordan PM: good notes — can we get rough pri scores? Which of these are renewal-risk vs nice-to-have?

Maya CS: Pri scores from customer conversations: per-route billing = P0 (seen in 4 deals at risk), embedding batch updates = P1 (frustration, slows onboarding), pin model variant in UI = P2 (ops convenience).

Sam Eng: For embedding perf — can you paste one example request id? I want to check queuing behavior.

Priya CS: here's an anonymized example id: req_2026-03-15_0043. Customer said: 'submitted 50 items, progress stuck at 0 for 40s, then all processed'.

Sam Eng: looks like our default batch window kicked in — we batch up to 200ms or 128 items. Might increase max batch threshold for small customers. Will run a quick test.

Blake Design: UI ask for pinning model variants — suggestion: small dropdown next to route name, default 'inherit'. We can mock in a morning.

Jordan PM: thanks. Action items: 1) Sam to sanity-check embedding batching change + quick perf test (target: 2 days) 2) Maya/Priya to assemble list of impacted customers with ARR and renewal dates 3) Blake to prototype pin UX and share screenshot in #design-review 4) PM will triage per-route billing into backlog with cost-model impact.

Maya CS: I'll add customers to a shared doc and tag renewal dates. Quick note: one of the customers asked for per-route toggle that is enforced per-team (multi-tenant on one account) — might need RBAC consideration.

Jordan PM: adding RBAC note. Also want a simple temporary workaround: Maya, can CS add a recommended prompt to ops guide telling customers to use a separate route for high-volume experiments until we ship toggle?

Maya CS: yep will send suggested copy.

deploy-bot: Note: feature-flag "embeds-progress-ui" currently off in prod. Toggle available on staging for Blake to demo.

Blake Design: grabbing staging flag now, will post mockup by EOD.

Sam Eng: running perf run now against req_2026-03-15_0043 pattern, will post results in thread by EOD. If we see consistent 8-12s tail, propose temporary change: decrease batching window to 50ms for onboarded customers.

Priya CS: adding customer quotes and renewal impact notes to shared doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/links/ONBOARD-VOICE-123 (internal).

Maya CS: thanks team — can we sync again Wednesday during CS standup if any blockers? :thumbsup:
